desc: (b) codex payload is Responses-shaped: system/developer blocks become instructions; controller prose (bootstrap/tool contract) rides as its own user input item at its chronological position — nothing dropped, but instructions stays short/system-only like codex_cli_rs (CLI-shape parity, next-horizon F1.3). Anti-echo note: DEBUG-R8 RC1 echo is caused by instructions buried INSIDE ~41k one-line JSON message content at ~68k scale (soft mode), not by gap-prose placement; a plain-text user item is not JSON-buried and carries no duplication either way. store:false + stream:true mandatory, conversation_id never sent
